text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the wind even better today. 
Looks like I'm really focused.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then let us embrace the wind to our 
heart's content in training.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what an unusual breeze... Is there 
something over that way?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! I had no idea a place like this 
existed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The breeze feels wonderful too... It's so 
soothing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I want to stay right here, feeling the 
wind forever...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Yamanin Zephyr lost track of 
time feeling the wind, ending up skipping 
her training altogether.
